description: Fix Play Together host song skipping: when host skips a song, guest immediately skips to the exact new song instead of replaying the previous song.
changelog: Fixed Play Together host song skip desync: guests now immediately transition to the new song when host skips
Prevented fake in-track SEEK(0ms) calls during track transitions which previously caused the old song to restart from the beginning
Enabled persistent keystore with v1 JAR + v2 APK signature schemes to eliminate 'Can't install app / There's a problem with the app file' on different devices
Added immediate requestSync fallback if guest receives remote skip without a matching queue window
